board.name: AI Squared
board.content: At AI Squared, our vision is to foster widespread AI adoption by embedding AI insights directly into mission-critical business applications and everyday workflows.  By leveraging AI Squared’s platform, organizations can access and integrate any data or machine-learning insight directly into their web-based business applications – leading to data-driven decisions and ML-powered innovation.
